CSVQA_FRAMES = {t["table_id"]: pd.DataFrame([r["values"] for r in t["records"]], columns=t["columns"], index=[r["source_row"] for r in t["records"]]) for t in CSVQA_DATA["tables"]}
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

def solve_problem(CSVQA_FRAMES):
    frame = CSVQA_FRAMES["file_0_view_0"]
    # Select products where "Product Name" starts with "TABLET"
    products = []
    revenue = {}
    demand = {}
    inventory = {}
    for source_row, row in frame.iterrows():
        pname = row["Product Name"]
        if isinstance(pname, str) and pname.casefold().startswith("tablet"):
            products.append(pname)
            try:
                revenue[pname] = float(row["Revenue"])
            except Exception:
                raise ValueError(f"Missing or invalid Revenue for {pname}")
            try:
                demand[pname] = int(float(row["Demand"]))
            except Exception:
                raise ValueError(f"Missing or invalid Demand for {pname}")
            try:
                inventory[pname] = int(float(row["Initial Inventory"]))
            except Exception:
                raise ValueError(f"Missing or invalid Initial Inventory for {pname}")
    # Validate all products have all coefficients
    if not (set(products) == set(revenue) == set(demand) == set(inventory)):
        raise ValueError("Coefficient dimension mismatch among products, revenue, demand, inventory.")
    m = gp.Model("TABLET_Revenue_Maximization")
    m.setParam("MIPGap", 1e-4)
    x_vars = m.addVars(products, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, lb=0, name="x")
    m.setObjective(gp.quicksum(revenue[i] * x_vars[i] for i in products), GRB.MAXIMIZE)
    m.addConstrs((x_vars[i] <= inventory[i] for i in products), name="inventory")
    m.addConstrs((x_vars[i] <= demand[i] for i in products), name="demand")
    m.optimize()
    if m.Status == GRB.OPTIMAL:
        print(f'ObjVal: {m.ObjVal}')
        for v in m.getVars():
            print(f'{v.VarName}: {v.X}')
    else:
        print(f'Solver status: {m.Status}')
    return m
